quote: Regular Graphs of High Degree are 1-Factorizable
posed_by: A. G. Chetwynd and A. J. W. Hilton
note: Chetwynd and Hilton explicitly formulated the conjecture in 1985. G. A. Dirac is credited with discussing the problem informally in the 1950s, but no specific published work by Dirac on 1-factorization could be located; therefore 1985 represents the first explicit formal statement in the literature.
